fieldValues.title: Field
fieldValues.description: The atomic reusable semantic unit: one named, versioned, UUID-identified piece of meaning, defined once and composed into any number of Types. A Field owns its own semantics completely — its value contract and its AI guidance belong to the Field and may not be redefined, overridden or duplicated by a Type that includes it. If a context needs different meaning, that is a different Field with its own identity and lineage, not a local override.
fieldValues.notes: Invariants 1-3 and 9 carry the Field's non-negotiables: rendering labels change nothing, Types may not restate Field semantics, and a new id means a new definition and not a new version.
